work: The Meaning Of The Drinking Festivity In The Districts
heading: Liji 42 · Xiang Yin Jiu Yi 鄉飲酒義 · The Meaning Of The Drinking Festivity In The Districts · Xiang Yin Jiu Yi 11 … Xiang Yin Jiu Yi 19

items.text: Show brotherly deference to your elders; give them precedence when the cup circulates and do not omit anyone due honor.
items.quote: Young and old pledge one another according to their age... practise brotherly deference to their elders without omitting any one.

items.text: Receive guests with bows and yieldings; present the cup to them and receive it in return; escort them out with bows.
items.quote: The host presents to him the cup, and receives the cup from him in return... the host bows to each as he escorts him away.

work: The Meaning Of The Drinking Festivity In The Districts
heading: Liji 42 · Xiang Yin Jiu Yi 鄉飲酒義 · The Meaning Of The Drinking Festivity In The Districts · Xiang Yin Jiu Yi 1 … Xiang Yin Jiu Yi 10

items.text: Honor elders: when they sit, stand and be ready to receive their orders and perform services.
items.quote: those who were sixty years old sat, and those who were only fifty stood, and were in waiting to receive any orders and perform any services

items.text: Nourish the aged: set more dishes before them as their years increase.
items.quote: Before those who were sixty, three dishes were placed; before those of seventy, four; before those of eighty, five; before those of ninety, six

items.text: Practice filial piety at home toward your parents.
items.quote: then at home they could practise filial piety

items.text: Practice fraternal duty toward your elder siblings.
items.quote: then at home they could practise fraternal duty
